caption: This drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock with two sections on its front. The upper section contains a circular clock face with black numbers and hands on a white background, framed with a decorative border featuring green leaves and red-orange fruit, likely cherries, in the corners. The clock hands are set at approximately 10:12. Below the clock face, in a separate panel, there is a painted scene bordered by concentric yellow, red, and green rings. This scene features two figures: one seated on a yellow object and dressed in light blue, and the other standing and dressed in yellow, with both figures set against a background that includes a brown tree and earth tones. The overall frame of the clock is shown in a dark brown wood color, with shading to indicate depth. The clock is positioned on a plain light background with some faint brown tinting and minor stains, and the artist's signature, "Dana Bartlett," is present at the bottom right corner.
title: Clock, Seth Thomas
